[{"label":"a","letter":"a","text":"Find the height of the helicopter.","marks":0,"answer":"Let H be the point on the ground directly below the helicopter O, and let h = OH (the height).
Let HA = x and HB = y, where A and B are on opposite sides of H, so x + y = 1000 m.
From the angle of depression to A (60°):
tan 60° = h/x → √3 = h/x → x = h/√3
From the angle of depression to B (30°):
tan 30° = h/y → 1/√3 = h/y → y = h√3
Using x + y = 1000:
h/√3 + h√3 = 1000
h(1/√3 + √3) = 1000
h(1/√3 + 3/√3) = 1000
h(4/√3) = 1000
h = 1000√3/4 = 250√3 m
∴ Height of helicopter = 250√3 ≈ 433.01 m
","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"b","letter":"b","text":"Find the distance of the helicopter from A.","marks":0,"answer":"OA is the slant distance from helicopter O to point A.
Using the angle of depression of 60°:
sin 60° = h/OA → OA = h/sin 60° = 250√3 ÷ (√3/2) = 250√3 × 2/√3 = 500 m
∴ Distance OA = 500 m

sin 30° = h/OB → OB = h/sin 30° = 250√3 ÷ (1/2) = 500√3 m

Proof of sin 3θ = 3 sin θ − 4 sin³θ using compound angle expansion:
sin 3θ = sin(2θ + θ)
= sin 2θ · cos θ + cos 2θ · sin θ
= (2 sin θ cos θ) · cos θ + (1 − 2sin²θ) · sin θ
= 2 sin θ cos²θ + sin θ − 2sin³θ
= 2 sin θ(1 − sin²θ) + sin θ − 2sin³θ
= 2 sin θ − 2sin³θ + sin θ − 2sin³θ
= 3 sin θ − 4 sin³θ (Proved)
Verification with θ = 30°:
LHS = sin 90° = 1
RHS = 3(1/2) − 4(1/8) = 3/2 − 1/2 = 1 ✓
","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"c","letter":"c","text":"Find the height of the tree.","marks":0,"answer":"The broken part makes 60° with the ground and touches it 15 m from the foot.
Let broken part length = b and standing part height = h.
Horizontal component: b × cos 60° = 15 → b × 0.5 = 15 → b = 30 m
Vertical component (= standing height): h = b × sin 60° = 30 × (√3/2) = 15√3 m
Total height of tree = h + b = 15√3 + 30 m
∴ Height of tree = (30 + 15√3) ≈ 55.98 m
","image":null,"image_url":null}]
